title: Moving a saved copy from 38.31, 38.28 and the 25.0 to 38.26 builds into the new shape: every saved field to its target, or listed
written_in: SCHEMA_V3 0, 2, 11 and 11.1; DECISIONS_ROUND2 E1, E6, H9, I5, J2, K3, O (and its watch items), X1, X9 and X watch, Y, Z, AA, AB, AC, AD (AD5 its second sentence only), AE (AE2 withdraws AD5's first), AF1, AG and AH4 (AG1 withdrawn as worded; mv-122); foundation_review/MOVE_FIELDS.md (the field list per build)
notes: Every amount is made up. Amounts in a saved copy are major units with up to two decimals (every build); the moved records hold whole minor units [section 0]; an amount with more decimals than its currency is rounded half up and flagged in `rounded` [Y23].

Question `move`: `copy` is the saved copy as an object, or `raw` the stored text itself (the move reads the raw text, never a cleaned copy [O]). `idb` is the IndexedDB second copy (`{ rev, t }`, `t` the moment of its save, a time or ms); `now` is the move's own moment, with the moving device's offset (X9), which is also `offset` unless given. The copy's last save is the later of `idb.t` and the stored `rev` when it is a time, either alone, else `now` [Y13, AA10]; its day is "the copy's last saved day" [H9, K3]. The move month is the calendar month of `now` [Y21]. `answers` holds the answers to the move's questions: `cur` (the currency code), `loanLine` (a plan.debts id, or `drop`), `pay` (`{ a, b, side }`: each a rule, SCHEMA_V3 5, any rhythm [AA4]), `billDay` (by 38.31 line id, a rule), `debtDay` (by debt id, or the field path of a loan the move made: the payment day), `goalMoney` (by goal id: `bank`, or `{ name, type }` for another account, type `bank` or `ewallet` [AA13]), `loanTerms` (by the id of a loan the move made: `{ apr, min }` or `dontKnow` [AA12]). `make.receipts` adds that many plain receipts to the copy (test help, so mv-35 can hold 5,002 receipts).

The answer is the moved copy: `v`, `home`, `people`, `accounts`, `places`, `schedules`, `events`, `plan` (`shares`, `budgets`, `limits`), `imports`, `ui` (the shared screen answers), `device` (`look`, `tour`, `opens`), `asks` (the move's questions, `minBank` when a minimum is dropped as automatic [AD1], each answered one with its `answer`), `unplaced` (every saved field with no target, kept in frozen3831 or on the shared ui as 11.1 says, which the move test lists [11.1]), `pendingMove` (kept on the copy [AA5]: each one-month amount and month-end answer whose pay, bill or payment day is not answered yet, a month-end answer for a period not ended at the move [AB2], and a receipt on bill:loan while the loan question waits [AC2]; each a record `{ id: 'mv:pend:<field path>', field, waits, to, ... }` [AB rows], written when what it waits for is answered and then kept marked `gone`; what the move itself writes, or an answer given at the move settles, is kept marked `gone` on the move day [AD5]), `zero` (the move summary of what is not moved: lines and pay amounts that are 0 every month [Y25], and the loan line's one-month amounts when the line is dropped [AD2]), `rounded` [Y23], `morePays` (the 38.31 fields whose one-month amount is spread over a month with more pays or payments than usual: three every two weeks, five weekly [AE4, AG2]), `sample`, `saved` (the copy's last save) and `frozen3831` (the raw text; the stored copy keeps it as the record `mv:frozen:<by>` in `frozen` [AB1]). `show` picks parts (`frozenIds` lists the `frozen` records' ids, `pendingMoveIds` the entries still waiting) (`plan.limits` picks one part of plan; `tally` counts the spends and adds them up; `ids` lists every record id; `payAmounts` gives each pay's amount on the days `payAt` names [AA4]); `pick` gives single fields as "list id field"; `omit` leaves a field out everywhere. Records carry `told` only on events; `at` and `by` are written by `move_two` and `move_later` (the copy's last save [AB1]) and by `move_answer` on what an answer changed (`answeredAt`). `move_two` with `cloud` and `move_later` with `cloud`: the desktop finds the phone's moved copy in the cloud and takes it, adding only the ids it lacks [AB1]; without, both copies meet in the merge.

Ids [X1, Y28, Z]: `mv:<kind>:<38.31 id, key or field path>` with the kinds of MOVE_FIELDS.md section 7: acct, card, debt, place, bill, line, pay, auto, item, share, person, open, check, rc, and `move` for the Emergency fund draw's move out of its place (`mv:move:once.<month>.draw`, AA6, a reading). A month-end answer is the period-end record `pe:<occurrence>:free` [Y8].

The opening [B6, B7, 11.1]: the oldest bank figure (bankStart or bankNow; on the same day bankNow [Y22]) opens the bank with an `open` and a `check` on its day; a newer figure is a later `check`. A figure's day with no time is told at the end of that day, or at the copy's last save when that is earlier [Y1]. The opening day is that figure's day, else the copy's last saved day. Goal money kept in the bank is the open's `split` [B6]; the rest of the split (budget lines and Free to spend left, Waiting) is the opening's own question [B2, I4] and is not written by the move.

Question `move_two` [X1, Y12]: `phone` and `desktop` each hold a `move` input plus `by` (the device part). Each device moves its own copy and stamps every record with `told` (events keep their own), `at` (its `now`) and `by`; the two moved copies are merged with rules/merge_ref.js.

Question `move_answer` [AA5]: the copy is moved with `answers`, then the days in `later` (`pay`, `billDay`, `debtDay`) are answered on the moved copy and what waits in `pendingMove` for them is written.

Question `apply_waiting` [AD5, AE2, AG1]: `copy` is a stored copy (records with `at` and `by`, `pendingMove` among them), `rules` the days answered now by schedule or account id, `moveDay` the move's day (it still decides which periods had ended, AB2), `answeredAt` and `by` the answer's stamp, `lastSeen` (optional) the newest `at` the device has seen beyond the copy. Every write made now uses the D4 clock: the larger of `answeredAt` and the newest `at` seen (the copy's own included) plus 1 ms [AG1]. Each live entry whose day is now known is applied once [AE2]: what it writes carries the entry's `at` and is judged as the merge judges it, record by record and key by key [AE1]; an entry a restore brought back (its `at` newer than its `told`) writes with the D4 clock instead, so it never ties with the restore's removal [AG1]. Either way it is kept marked `gone` with the answer's day, `at` and `by`.

Sample data is never moved as real (requirements 1c): the sample shows while ui.done lacks pay, bills or goals, unless the copy is blank or cleared (every build's `sampleOn`). Receipts, cards and a typed bank figure are the person's and move as real [Y16].

The expected outputs of mv-01 to mv-45 were re-worked by hand from MOVE_FIELDS.md, SCHEMA_V3 11.1 and the decisions (Y and Z included), not taken from the reference; mv-46 to mv-67 were written by hand for Y and Z, and mv-68 and mv-69 for the coverage grid's move row (COVERAGE.md). Every open question below names what the reference does. mv-70 to mv-81 were written by hand for AA, and mv-07, mv-15, mv-33, mv-46, mv-49, mv-51, mv-52 and mv-65 re-worked by hand for it. Four cases show what the reference does on an open question AA leaves: mv-72 (mv-q45, the draw's move to Waiting; mv-q46, the debt's `amounts`), mv-75 and mv-76 (mv-q47, the receipt's own note); mv-73 leaves `per` (mv-q42) out of its view. mv-82 to mv-99 were written by hand for AB and AC (and the reviewer's d1; mv-97 to mv-99 for the coverage grid's new column L), and mv-09, mv-10, mv-15, mv-29, mv-33, mv-42, mv-46, mv-49, mv-52, mv-71, mv-72, mv-73, mv-75 and mv-76 re-worked by hand for them; AC answered mv-q42 to mv-q49. mv-100 to mv-108 were written by hand for AD (AD1, AD2, AD4, AD5), and mv-09 (its why), mv-33, mv-46, mv-52, mv-73, mv-75, mv-89, mv-90, mv-94, mv-98 and mv-99 re-worked by hand for AD5 before the reference changed; mv-45 (a 25.0 copy with a minimum) was re-worked by hand for AD1 after the first run of the changed reference showed AD1 reaches it. AD answered mv-q50 to mv-q54; mv-q55 is what AD1 leaves. mv-117 to mv-121 were written by hand for AG (mv-117 and mv-118 for AG1, mv-119 to mv-121 for AG2), and mv-111 to mv-113 re-worked for AG2: the move summary's list is `morePays` (was `threePays`). AG answered mv-q56 and mv-q57.

cases.question: move
cases.title: once[ym]: a budget line's goes to the first period starting that month, pay and bill ones to that month's occurrence; the shares and goals to that period's plan.shares entry; a debt's waits for its payment day (Y2, Y7, AA5, AA6)
cases.why: The pay is answered monthly on the 25th, so the first period starting in January starts with the pay due Mon 25 Jan 2027: the Food line's 50,000 is its `once` for that occurrence [11.1, T1, units-78]. a's 1,000 is that month's pay: `amounts` on the 25 Jan occurrence [Y2, AA4]. Rent is answered due on the 27th: its 0 for January is `amounts` on 27 Jan [Y7]. envelope's 25,000 (Free to spend) and goal:trip's 9,000 are `once` on the plan.shares entry of that period, keyed by the same occurrence: the entry in force on 25 Jan is the one from the opening [AA6]. That entry holds Free to spend's 15,000 and the trip's 100: the trip has no date and no monthly, so it takes 38.31's figure, a twelfth of what is missing rounded up to 38.31's unit: 1 - 0 = 1, 1 / 12 = 0.08, up to the unit 100 (the largest month's pay 250,000 is 20,000 or more) = 100 [AA11]. side has only a one-month amount, so it is a stream (0 from the opening) whose day is not answered: its January 30,000 waits in `pendingMove` for that answer [AA5]. debt:car's 400 is that month's payment occurrence `amounts` on the car loan [AA6]; its payment day is not answered, so it waits in `pendingMove` too [AA5]. The copy has no Emergency fund, so the draw of 20,000 has no fund to come out of and is listed. Each pay stream is `per: 'month'` [AB2, AC1]; with one pay a month a one-month amount spread over the month's one pay is the whole amount [AB2]. Each `pendingMove` entry is a record with its own id, `mv:pend:<field path>` [AB rows, Y28]. The debt's 400 is the whole January payment [AC5]. The five one-month amounts written at the move (the salary's 1,000, Food's 50,000, the rent's 0, the free share's 25,000 and the trip's 9,000) are also kept in `pendingMove` marked `gone` on the move day, Tue 24 Nov, so a device that moved the same copy without these answers drops its waiting entries for them [AD5].
